translations.web: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.
translations.bsb: The earth is utterly broken apart, the earth is split open, the earth is shaken violently.
translations.kjv: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
translations.asv: The earth is utterly broken, the earth is rent asunder, the earth is shaken violently.
